title: SCP-1529, King of the Mountain
description: Be cautious when walking on mountains... An entity might find his way to you
body:
The King of the Mountain adds a new creature. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1529 also known as the King of the Mountain.


SCP-1529 inhabits the highest and coldest mountain peaks, remaining dormant until players venture too high. Unlike typical hostile creatures, SCP-1529 behaves more like a looming presence. It can stalk players and if a players went to high above y-level 120, SCP-1529 will walk towards their location and slowy killing them by hypothermia.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-1529 spawn?

SCP-1529 can spawn in Snowy slopes, frozen peaks and jagged peaks in the overworld like a normal monster above y-level 120. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-1529.

</details>



![SCP-1529](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c31a046dbe0529130943095f296af5817a5b9191.png)

SCP-1529 is a humanoid entity that spawns on snowy slopes, frozen peaks or jagged peaks biomes above Y-level 120. It is unaffected by fall damage, does not sink into powder snow, and can climb 8 blocks tall walls. When no players is within 30 blocks, SCP-1529 remains completely dormant. Sometimes, SCP-1529 will stare at the player. If a player is up to 20 blocks in his sighting range, or within 80 blocks above y-level 120 on nighttime, or within 40 blocks above y-level 120, SCP-1529 will begin slowly moving toward their position. Once within 20 blocks of it's sighting range, the entity becomes hostile, causing the victim to freeze, weaken, and slow as its glowing eyes lock onto its target. At extremely close range, SCP-1529 will stop moving, forcing eye contact while the player is immobilized and confronted with a message from SCP-1529 "You would refuse my gift?". Most of the time, this would kill the victim due to Hypothermia, but if the player has more than 10 health left, and attacking SCP-1529 with strong attacks, causes the entity to vanish in a burst of cold mist, releasing the player from its influence.
